packageRules.description: expressly 6 declares Require-Capability JavaSE 17 in its manifest, and this build runs on every LTS from 11. Hibernate Validator needs an expression language to interpolate its messages, so raising this makes the JDK 11 legs fail with HV000183.

bval-jsr 2.x is the javax.validation provider and 3.x is the jakarta one. owner-extras tests both namespaces and needs one provider for each, so raising this turns the javax half into a second jakarta provider and stops testing it. Hibernate Validator covers jakarta; this covers javax; they must not become the same thing.
